access_route.text: the last bell-ringer walks them in through the casting floor door, keys jingling on his belt

cipher_form.text: peal changes: read each pull as long or short and let the repeating phrase spell out the setting

access_route.text: a spare foundry key hung on a nail behind the loose flue grate, exactly where the note's fold points
a catch hidden under the tuning board's lip trips the side door open if you know where to press

curiosity.text: a small hand bell cast crooked on purpose, the founder's first failed attempt kept as a joke

hint_carrier.text: a rack of tuning forks sorted low to high, each one labeled with a pull count

curiosity.text: sun through the coloured glass transom scatters bell-shaped light across the pattern room floor

hint_carrier.text: a tuning hammer with the founder's own notes scratched along the handle, each mark keyed to a pull
a brass calibration scale bolted by the mould bench, its notches climbing by the same carry the peals use

obstacle.text: the bell-frame catwalk, planks slick with tallow, crossed one handhold at a time between the swinging cradles

curiosity.text: Josiah Vane's own leather apron, still hanging by the casting floor, pockets worn to the shape of his tools

hint_carrier.text: noon light through the belfry louvers falls across a marked floor plank, lining up with the peal's count

remedy.text: releasing the cradle's safety catch and easing it back to rest resets the jammed pull

contents.text: Josiah Vane's own marking chisel, kept oiled as though he'd be back for it

loft_signature.text: every casting tool racked and labeled, ready for a workday that never resumed

n_end_secret.mechanism: his notes name whoever finds the room its steward, and they accept, as if he had been waiting

safeguard.text: a trip-wire strung to a hand bell rings the yard the moment a hand strays near the vault

n_end_caught.mechanism: second thoughts slow them just enough for the keeper's evening rounds to find them mid-return

n_end_library.mechanism: a page in the archive holds a copy of the note, carried home so the translation can continue

n_end_giveup.mechanism: a slip caught in time turns the attempt into a calm, deliberate retreat

n_end_timeout.mechanism: random guessing trips a protection he built, freezing the setting until a keeper resets it

n_end_stuck.mechanism: a bent linkage needs a workshop tool nobody brought, exactly the kind he kept on hand

n_end_hero.mechanism: the recovered story is shared publicly and the settlement remembers him properly at last

n_end_keepsake.mechanism: they leave everything exactly as found, keeping the story and leaving the rest

label_style: first-person plural resolves: what we do next
